name: Data Pipeline
author: SUTRA
description: Source → normalize → validate → store, with idempotent, resumable steps.

steps.title: Source
steps.detail: Read from source with a watermark (cursor), never a full re-scan on resume.

steps.title: Normalize
steps.detail: Coerce types, trim, dedupe by natural key. Log every dropped row with a reason.

steps.title: Validate
steps.detail: Schema + constraints. Quarantine invalid rows; never fail the batch for one bad row.

steps.title: Store
steps.detail: Upsert into sink. Idempotent: re-running the same batch is a no-op.

definitionOfDone: re-running the batch changes nothing; every dropped/quarantined row has a logged reason.
